Part.name: ATGM launcher
Part.description: Square tube for launcher ATGM profiles. Requires a native gunner. Each launcher starts with one ready missile per new combat instance when InitialReadyMissile is enabled (default). After the first shot, compatible reserve ammunition and normal manual loading or the optional automatic ATGM ammo box are required. Automatic ammo-box loading within 2 metres uses AutomaticAmmoBox in the ATGM Launcher Tests config section; restart after changing these settings. Place the muzzle outside armour. Native dates control availability.
